_comment: Manifest for the REAL in-VM `exec` demo. `exec` overwrites `goal` with the
actual command spec before dispatch, so the text here is never read — only
grant/budget/isolation_floor matter. exec: Sandboxed is what lets the
demo's `echo` actually run inside the box; try exec: None to see the
denial-before-boot path (the guest still boots, mediates, and reports the
denial without ever spawning the command).

goal.description: unused — overwritten by the exec spec
